messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P2 — elevated error rates and incorrect model outputs for requests routed to us-east-1. Initial symptom: repeated user complaints about hallucinations + degraded embeddings. See alert link: https://alerts.redwood/alert/3782 :rotating_light:
olivia (oncall): I'm on it. reading alert now. which customers?
jamie (customer-success): seeing 3 customers reporting wrong outputs — 2 internal canaries + ACME corp. ACME says responses are coming from a 'smaller-model' even though they requested gptx-large.
raj (sre): adding logs. I'm seeing spike in fallback events where policy selected variant `gptx-small-quant` instead of `gptx-large`. Routing trace: `route->us-east-1->policy:fallback-tier->variant:gptx-small-quant`.
maria (runtime): that shouldn't happen — fallback should pick same variant family in region. Could be cache key mismatch in KV prefix causing variant-agnostic reuse.
derek (eng-platform): can you paste a trace id? I want to inspect KV lookup/put sequence.
raj (sre): trace 1782349012-abc123 snippet: ```
LOOKUP cache:prefix=customer:acme|model=gptx-large|region=us-east -> MISS
ROUTE default->us-west-2
PUT cache:prefix=customer:acme|model=gptx-small-quant|region=us-east -> HIT_SUBSEQUENT
```
olivia (oncall): so the cache put used wrong model tag on the key? That explains reuse across model variants. Is prefix generation pulling from the effective_model field instead of requested_model?
maria (runtime): yes, there's a race in routing code: when region fallback happens we set effective_model to the variant previously selected; then cache key builder uses `effective_model` instead of `requested_model`. So later requests hit the wrong cached KV.
derek (eng-platform): ok mitigation plan? We need to stop writes with the wrong key and invalidate contaminated keys.
raj (sre): immediate mitigation: disable KV caching for routed fallbacks by flipping config `cache.allow_on_fallback=false` in prod. I can deploy that in 2 mins.
olivia (oncall): do it. also page eng-runtime + platform.
derek (eng-platform): I'm deploying a hotflag: `route.cache_on_fallback=false` to all us-east hosts. rolling now.
squad-ai-bot: deploy started: canary 5% -> 20% -> 100%, ETA ~6m.
maria (runtime): while that's rolling, we should evict contaminated keys for affected customers. Where are they stored? memcached shard `kv-routing-3`.
raj (sre): I can run a targeted evict using prefix `customer:acme|region:us-east|*`. Command: ```
redis-cli -h kv-routing-3 --scan --pattern 'customer:acme|region:us-east|*' | xargs -r redis-cli -h kv-routing-3 del
```
jamie (customer-success): please include canary customer ids in the eviction — we need to confirm they return to expected outputs.
maria (runtime): also adding temporary logging to reject any cache PUTs where `requested_model != cache_key.model` and increment metric `cache.put.mismatch`. Patch pushed to canary now.
derek (eng-platform): canaries green at 20%. pushing to 100% in 2m.
squad-ai-bot: deploy succeeded to 100% at 1782349800.
olivia (oncall): observed error rate dropping in us-east. but still a few mismatches reported.
raj (sre): I ran the eviction for top 20 affected customers at 1782349955. Post-evict check shows miss rates returning to baseline.
jamie (customer-success): ACME confirms responses look correct again. :thumbsup: they reported regression cleared at 1782350500.
maria (runtime): next step: code fix to cache key builder to always use `requested_model` plus `region` and `variant_tag` so no ambiguity. I'll open PR now and attach tests.
derek (eng-platform): agree. also plan to add stricter invariants in routing state machine to avoid writing effective-only attributes into cache keys.
tim (product): what's customer impact? severity P2 but multiple paying customers affected — do we need proactive outreach?
jamie (customer-success): ACME got an incident update and waived through. I'll send a dedicated note to the 3 affected customers and offer replay of requests.
olivia (oncall): handoff to day ops: I'm going to create an incident summary and assign follow-up tasks: fix PR, add regression test, add alert for `cache.put.mismatch` > 0.
maria (runtime): PR 4521 created: `fix(cache-key): use requested_model for key generation`. includes unit & integration tests. ETA review 3h.
raj (sre): postmortem actions I'm adding: 1) alert on cache mismatch metric 2) playbook step to disable cache_on_fallback 3) eviction script in runbook 4) add end-to-end canary that verifies variant equality across fallbacks.
derek (eng-platform): planning a small release to make cache keys include `(requested_model, region, variant_hash)` to avoid collisions. target next deploy window.
olivia (oncall): final: incident status -> mitigated at 1782351200. customer impact: ACME and two canaries saw downgraded model variants for ~18 minutes total. No data exfiltration.
jamie (customer-success): customers notified. CS tickets updated.
tim (product): add to roadmap: stronger fallback policy invariants + RBAC on routing-policy edits.
squad-ai-bot: incident closed by olivia at 1782355800.
olivia (oncall): I'll write short blameless postmortem draft and drop in #postmortems. thanks all for quick response.
